description:
In a world governed by the laws of the “Nameverse”, soulmates are marked by the literal spelling of their partner's name upon their skin.

When the elite, third-generation chaebol heir Woo Baek-yeon and the easygoing former bodyguard Jung Han-kyung suddenly manifest each other's names, the intense sensory rush triggers an explosive public incident at a crowded wedding hall. A video of their dramatic, passionate first kiss instantly goes viral, forcing the cold and fiercely private Baek-yeon to present Han-kyung with a three-year marriage contract to appease his family and control the media frenzy. The duo crafts a fabricated backstory claiming to be old high school friends who reunited through destiny, plunging the straight-identified Han-kyung into a domestic layout with a drop-dead gorgeous man.

As they transition from formal partners to roommates navigating the slip of casual boundaries, Baek-yeon's icy exterior melts into a fiercely coy, flustered devotion, while Han-kyung's playful teasing gives way to a deeper affection that threatens to permanently rewrite the boundaries of their temporary arrangement.

**Original Novel:**  
Volumes: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/120076535), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000155554), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/marriage_pink_ebook), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=925049653), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/novel/detail.series?productNo=13358734)
